title: MI21002: Mine Surveying
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Fundamentals of surveying, Levelling, Levelling instruments, Theodolites,
Tachometry, Triangulation, Contouring, EDM and modern instruments, Errors and
adjustments. Correlation, stope and open pit surveying, Curves, Mine plan and
projection, Photgrammetry, Field astronomy, Statutory requirements.Introduction
to geodesy, geodetic surveying and GPS.
